## Consolidated State Minimum Wage and Overtime tables

US Department of Labor · US · public domain (US government) — quote freely

<https://www.dol.gov/agencies/whd/state/minimum-wage/history>

**Authoritative for:** State-by-state minimum wage and state overtime rules in one maintained table, where the binding figure is whichever of state or federal is higher.

## IRS forms, instructions and publications

US Internal Revenue Service · US · public domain (US government) — quote freely

<https://www.irs.gov/forms-instructions>

**Authoritative for:** Current-year thresholds, rates, limits and filing mechanics. Instructions carry the numbers that change annually and that a model built last year has wrong.

## State Labor Offices directory

US Department of Labor · US · public domain (US government) — quote freely

<https://www.dol.gov/agencies/whd/state/contacts>

**Authoritative for:** Which state agency to ask, and its site, when an employment question turns on state rather than federal law. There is no single open source for fifty states — this is the index that gets you to the right one.

## Wage and Hour Division

US Department of Labor · US · public domain (US government) — quote freely

<https://www.dol.gov/agencies/whd>

**Authoritative for:** Federal wage and hour obligation — overtime, the regular rate, exemption tests, child labor, family and medical leave — including the fact sheets and opinion letters the agency itself enforces against.
